description: This Java class 'AuthenticationFacade' provides methods to access the current authentication information and retrieve the authenticated user based on email, integrating with Spring Security and a UserService.

classes.name: AuthenticationFacade
classes.description: A Spring component that provides access to authentication details and the authenticated user.

methods.name: getAuthentication
methods.description: Returns the current Authentication object from Spring Security context.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedUser
methods.description: Retrieves the email from the current Authentication and fetches the corresponding User entity via UserService.
